claims.value: Seven alternative colour-triplet vector-like quark multiplets, one at a time: T,B singlets; XT,TB,BY doublets; XTB,TBY triplets. Component charges X=5/3,T=2/3,B=-1/3,Y=-4/3 fix Y=Q-T3, yielding 2/3,-1/3,7/6,1/6,-5/6,2/3,-1/3 respectively. Each source Dirac multiplet expands to LH R plus LH conjugate R; do not count dimensions as copies.

Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

fields.derivation: Exact highest weights use dynkin-gauge-1. prepare_entry expands identified 4D Dirac/RH fermions into LH conjugates of every factor, and applies one primitive positive charge unit over the entire inventory.
